8 Days / 7 Nights

Spiti : Full Summer Circuit

Delhi — Shimla — Sangla — Chitkul — Nako — Gue — Tabo — Dhankar — Kaza — Key — Kibber — Chandratal — Batal — Chhatru — Atal Tunnel — Manali — Delhi

About This Trip

Awara Banjara brings you the ultimate Spiti Valley Full Summer Circuit—an immersive 8-day expedition starting from Delhi and traversing through Shimla, Kinnaur, Kaza, Chandratal Lake, and Manali. Experience high-altitude mountain passes, ancient monasteries, remote border villages, and stunning Himalayan landscapes with expert-led guidance and community vibes.

Itinerary

8–9 hours)

Drive via Kinnaur Valley along the Sutlej River towards Chitkul, the last inhabited village near the Indo-Tibet border.

Visit Nako Lake, Nako Village, and the 500-year-old Mummy at Gue Monastery before entering Tabo.

Explore 1,000-year-old Tabo Monastery, then drive to Dhankar Monastery perched on a cliff before heading to Kaza.

Visit the highest villages & iconic spots: Hikkim (World's Highest Post Office), Komic (Highest Village connected by motorable road), and Langza (Fossil Village).

Visit iconic Key Monastery and Chicham Bridge (Asia's highest bridge). Drive over Kunzum Pass to reach the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake.

Cross rugged dirt tracks of Batal and Chhatru, pass through Atal Tunnel, and reach Manali.

Over-night drive back from Manali to Delhi, concluding the circuit expedition.
